conditions.displayName: Repeated trading admission blocks from insufficient inventory

documentation.content: The production `poly_bot` runtime repeatedly saw viable arbitrage candidates for one pair but rejected admission because non-transient available inventory was insufficient. The condition requires at least three matching blocks in a 15-minute window, sustained for five minutes. Same-asset `pending`, `inflight`, and `settlement` rebalance windows are excluded; `idle` and `quarantined` shortages remain actionable. Inspect `pair_id`, `shortage_asset`, `rebalance_phase`, and `claims`, then inspect the separate rebalance-fault incident and venue balances before forcing new trades.
